steps.name: environment
steps.description: Create runtime-safe environment persistence. Validate node and npm presence (report versions). Write /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh so npm global bin is resolved at shell runtime. If sudo is unavailable, fallback to writing WORKSPACE/.env with equivalent exports. Allow override of strict version checks via ALLOW_OLD_NODE=true for CI flexibility.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126435/DIGIO/NSDLeSign"
TMPFILE="/tmp/node_env.$$"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Validate presence
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: npm not found" >&2; exit 3; fi
NODE_VER_RAW=$(node -v || true)
NPM_VER_RAW=$(npm -v || true)
echo "$NODE_VER_RAW" > "$WORKSPACE/node.version"
echo "$NPM_VER_RAW" > "$WORKSPACE/npm.version"
# Soft version check (can be bypassed in CI)
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_VER_RAW" | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*$/\1/' || echo 0)
NPM_MAJOR=$(echo "$NPM_VER_RAW" | sed -E 's/^([0-9]+).*$/\1/' || echo 0)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ] || [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 9 ]; then
  if [ "${ALLOW_OLD_NODE:-false}" != "true" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Recommended node>=18 and npm>=9. Detected node=$NODE_VER_RAW npm=$NPM_VER_RAW. To override set ALLOW_OLD_NODE=true" >&2
    exit 4
  else
    echo "WARN: continuing with older node/npm (node=$NODE_VER_RAW npm=$NPM_VER_RAW)" > "$WORKSPACE/install.log"
  fi
fi
# Write POSIX runtime-evaluated profile that calls `npm bin -g` at shell source time
cat > "$TMPFILE" <<'SH'
# runtime node env for shells
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
# add npm global bin at runtime if npm exists
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPMG=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)
  # prepend resolved global bin to PATH when shell starts
  export PATH="${NPMG}:$PATH"
fi
SH
# Prefer to install system-wide if sudo available
if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo mv "$TMPFILE" /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
  sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
else
  mv "$TMPFILE" "$WORKSPACE/.env"
  chmod 644 "$WORKSPACE/.env"
  echo "INFO: sudo not available; wrote environment to $WORKSPACE/.env" > /dev/null
fi
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Deterministically create package-lock.json if missing and install all node dependencies with npm ci. Verify presence of local binaries (serve, jest). Writes install.log. This single step centralizes dependency management for scaffold, test, and validation steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126435/DIGIO/NSDLeSign"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/install.log"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Create package-lock deterministically if missing
if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm i --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 6)
fi
# Install dependencies deterministically
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 7)
# Verify required local binaries
for bin in serve jest; do
  if [ ! -x "./node_modules/.bin/$bin" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: required binary ./node_modules/.bin/$bin missing; check package.json and run deps-001" >&2
    exit 8
  fi
done
exit 0

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Build the React app, serve the build using the local ./node_modules/.bin/serve (no npx fallback), probe readiness with curl (nc fallback), verify response, stop server cleanly by killing its process group, and write machine-readable validation.summary.json with build_ok/server_ok/test_ok and tool versions. Requires deps-001 and test-001 to have completed.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126435/DIGIO/NSDLeSign"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
LOG="$WORKSPACE/validation.log"
BUILD_LOG="$WORKSPACE/build.log"
SUMMARY="$WORKSPACE/validation.summary.json"
PGIDFILE="$WORKSPACE/serve.pgid"
HTML_OUT="$WORKSPACE/validation.html"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
rm -f "$LOG" "$BUILD_LOG" "$SUMMARY" "$PGIDFILE" "$HTML_OUT"
# Build
npm run build --if-present > "$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || (jq -n --arg e "build_failed" '{build_ok:false,error:$e}' > "$SUMMARY"; cat "$BUILD_LOG" >&2; exit 12)
# Require local serve binary
if [ ! -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then echo "ERROR: local serve binary missing; run deps-001" >&2; exit 13; fi
# Start serve in its own process group so we can kill whole group
setsid ./node_modules/.bin/serve -s build -l "$PORT" > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# capture process group id
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$PID" | tr -d ' ' || echo "")
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then echo "$PGID" > "$PGIDFILE"; fi
# Readiness probe: prefer curl, fallback to nc
TRIES=0
SUCCESS=1
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  until curl -sSf --max-time 3 "http://localhost:$PORT" -o "$HTML_OUT" 2>/dev/null || [ $TRIES -ge 60 ]; do sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done
  if [ $TRIES -lt 60 ]; then SUCCESS=0; fi
elif command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  until nc -z localhost "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ $TRIES -ge 60 ]; do sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done
  if [ $TRIES -lt 60 ]; then
    curl -sSf --max-time 3 "http://localhost:$PORT" -o "$HTML_OUT" 2>/dev/null || true
    SUCCESS=0
  fi
else
  echo "ERROR: neither curl nor nc available for readiness probe" >&2
  SUCCESS=1
fi
# Determine test_ok from test log presence
TEST_OK=false
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/test.log" ]; then
  if ! grep -qi "FAIL" "$WORKSPACE/test.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; then TEST_OK=true; fi
fi
if [ "$SUCCESS" = 0 ]; then
  # write summary
  jq -n --arg node "$(cat node.version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" --arg npm "$(cat npm.version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" --argjson build true --argjson server true --argjson test $([ "$TEST_OK" = true ] && echo true || echo false) '{build_ok:$build,server_ok:$server,test_ok:$test,node_version:$node,npm_version:$npm}' > "$SUMMARY"
  echo "OK" > "$WORKSPACE/validation.result"
else
  jq -n --arg node "$(cat node.version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" --arg npm "$(cat npm.version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" --argjson build true --argjson server false --argjson test $([ "$TEST_OK" = true ] && echo true || echo false) '{build_ok:$build,server_ok:$server,test_ok:$test,node_version:$node,npm_version:$npm}' > "$SUMMARY"
  echo "VALIDATION FAILED: server did not respond" > "$WORKSPACE/validation.result"
fi
# Cleanup: kill process group if present
if [ -f "$PGIDFILE" ]; then
  PGID=$(cat "$PGIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -- -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
fi
# ensure PID fallback
if [ -n "${PID:-}" ]; then kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
exit 0

npm run build --if-present > "$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || (jq -n --arg e "build_failed" '{build_ok:false,error:$e}' > "$SUMMARY"; cat "$BUILD_LOG" >&2; exit 12)
# Require local serve binary
if [ ! -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then echo "ERROR: local serve binary missing; run deps-001" >&2; exit 13; fi
# Start serve in its own process group so we can kill whole group
setsid ./node_modules/.bin/serve -s build -l "$PORT" > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# capture process group id
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$PID" | tr -d ' ' || echo "")
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then echo "$PGID" > "$PGIDFILE"; fi
# Readiness probe: prefer curl, fallback to nc
TRIES=0
SUCCESS=1
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  until curl -sSf --max-time 3 "http://localhost:$PORT" -o "$HTML_OUT" 2>/dev/null || [ $TRIES -ge 60 ]; do sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done
  if [ $TRIES -lt 60 ]; then SUCCESS=0; fi
elif command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  until nc -z localhost "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ $TRIES -ge 60 ]; do sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done
  if [ $TRIES -lt 60 ]; then
    # try to capture response if curl exists; else leave HTML_OUT empty
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -sSf --max-time 3 "http://localhost:$PORT" -o "$HTML_OUT" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
    SUCCESS=0
  fi
else
  echo "ERROR: neither curl nor nc available for readiness probe" >&2
  SUCCESS=1
fi
# Determine test_ok from test log presence
TEST_OK=false
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/test.log" ]; then
  if ! grep -qi "FAIL" "$WORKSPACE/test.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; then TEST_OK=true; fi
fi
# Build succeeded at this point; write summary depending on server readiness
NODE_VER_FILE="node.version"
NPM_VER_FILE="npm.version"
NODE_VER="$(cat "$NODE_VER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
NPM_VER="$(cat "$NPM_VER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
if [ "$SUCCESS" = 0 ]; then
  jq -n --arg node "$NODE_VER" --arg npm "$NPM_VER" --argjson build true --argjson server true --argjson test $([ "$TEST_OK" = true ] && echo true || echo false) '{build_ok:$build,server_ok:$server,test_ok:$test,node_version:$node,npm_version:$npm}' > "$SUMMARY"
  echo "OK" > "$WORKSPACE/validation.result"
else
  jq -n --arg node "$NODE_VER" --arg npm "$NPM_VER" --argjson build true --argjson server false --argjson test $([ "$TEST_OK" = true ] && echo true || echo false) '{build_ok:$build,server_ok:$server,test_ok:$test,node_version:$node,npm_version:$npm}' > "$SUMMARY"
  echo "VALIDATION FAILED: server did not respond" > "$WORKSPACE/validation.result"
fi
# Cleanup: kill process group if present
if [ -f "$PGIDFILE" ]; then
  PGID=$(cat "$PGIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -- -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
fi
# ensure PID fallback
if [ -n "${PID:-}" ]; then kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
exit 0
